reconciledThrough.label: Where these numbers stop
reconciledThrough.detail: Bank statements close on a different day for every account, so there is no single cutoff. Every account is complete through June 8, most run through the end of June, and the Apple Cash lane through July 5. The one exception is ad spend: that comes straight from the Google and Meta accounts rather than the bank, so the Google figure is current through July 26. Nothing on this page is estimated forward to make a total look finished.

snapshot.heroHeadline: Ten homes closed. $102,472.87 earned, every dollar verified.
snapshot.heroSub: Six more are under contract or ratifying right now, an estimated $54,098 on top of what is already in.
snapshot.openingNote: Mom, Dad, your first $9,000 helped build a real engine. Ten closings since February, every figure pulled off signed documents. Six more homes are in contract as of today. This page is the full accounting, what is still in flight, and exactly how you get every dollar back.

That is why they sit in their own column and never get added to the verified total.
